no-restricted-syntax.message: Don't format dates with toLocaleDateString/toLocaleTimeString — the API sends UTC ISO strings and this renders in the machine's zone. Use lib/datetime.ts (formatTime, formatFullDate, formatLongDate, formatDateTime, formatRelativeDay, or formatDate(iso, tz, opts)) with the zone from useUserTimeZone(). Analytics: features/analytics/lib/format.ts, passing useUserTimeZone(). See CLAUDE.md §3.6.
Don't format a Date with .toLocaleString() — it renders in the machine's zone. Use lib/datetime.ts helpers with useUserTimeZone(). See CLAUDE.md §3.6.
